drive3.qualification: common-XOR inversion does not require knowing the stable drive3 polarity

scope: Qualifies active-high output enable, release, and drive-low electrical behavior for the exact four distinct PIN_25 through PIN_28 OE corridors in the retained vendor-routed quad composition. PIN_28 is proven by repeated inversion under the shared common XOR input; the uninstrumented PIN_20 input only selects polarity. The pull-down rows are required only to remain low when OE is asserted because a released open-drain line may also be pulled low. This does not qualify active drive-high, thresholds, slew/drive strength, other packages, the complete node's sequential/readback network, or ordinary source ingress to these OE presentation LUTs. The ordinary open flow remains qualified only for the existing PIN_10-controlled PIN_25 composition until its other control-ingress routes pass silicon.
